Need iOS App Store Review Specialist to Record Physical iPhone Walkthrough for Guideline 2.1
Posted last week

Only freelancers located in the U.S. may apply.

9 required Connects (114 available)
Summary

I am looking for an experienced iOS/App Store Review specialist to test my iOS app, LIVLIFE, on a physical iPhone and create a professional screen recording that I can submit to Apple App Review.

Apple has requested additional information under Guideline 2.1 – Information Needed and specifically requires a screen recording captured on a physical device running the latest iOS version.

The recording must begin from the iPhone Home Screen, show the app being launched, and demonstrate the typical user flow.

The walkthrough will need to include:

Launching LIVLIFE from the iPhone Home Screen
New client account registration
Login and logout
Main client dashboard
Browsing stylists
Opening a stylist profile
Selecting a service and beginning/completing the appointment booking flow
Virtual Closet
AI Outfit Generator
Messaging/chat functionality
Reporting user-generated content or a user
Blocking a user
Showing the Blocked Users section
Logging into the Stylist account
Showing the main Stylist dashboard and appointment functionality
Logging into a temporary account and demonstrating full Account Deletion

I will provide:

TestFlight access
Client test credentials
Stylist test credentials
Temporary account information
Apple's exact App Review message
A detailed recording sequence

Requirements:

You must own a physical iPhone capable of running the latest iOS
Experience with TestFlight
Familiarity with App Store Connect and Apple App Review
Experience testing iOS applications
Ability to provide the original, full-resolution iPhone screen recording
Ability to follow an exact walkthrough without exposing personal notifications or information

Experience resolving Apple App Store Guideline 2.1 review requests or App Store rejections is strongly preferred.

I would also like you to briefly identify any obvious problems you notice during testing that could cause another App Review rejection.

You will NOT need access to my Apple ID password or personal Apple account.
